app_id_digits: App ID must contain digits only.
app_secret_short: App Secret is missing or too short.
save_app_first: Save the App ID and App Secret first (step 2).
token_empty: The token looks empty. Copy it from Graph API Explorer and paste it here.
demo_real_connected: Demo data cannot be loaded while a real Meta connection exists. Use "Delete all data" in Settings first.
demo_no_api: Demo mode: no real API calls were made
pick_competitor_account: Select the account to link the competitor to.
competitor_note: Reach is not available for competitors; only public follower, post and like/comment counts are shown.
range_order: Start date cannot be after the end date.
no_tables: There is no table to export.
logo_invalid: The logo must be a PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG image (SVG without scripts).
logo_too_large: The logo is too large (max. 1 MB after resizing).
invalid_color: Enter the colour as a hex code, e.g. #4F7CFF.
http_only: Only http(s) links can be opened.
not_sqlite: The selected file is not an SQLite database.
not_transfer: The selected file is not a MetaDash export file.
no_tables_in_file: The file contains no MetaDash tables.
passphrase_required: The Meta token/secret in this file is passphrase-encrypted; enter the passphrase.
notify_anomalies_one: {names} shows unusual changes in the last 2 days.
notify_anomalies_many: {n} accounts have unusual changes in the last 2 days: {names}.
notify_budget_one: {name} has spent {pct}% of its monthly budget.
notify_budget_many: {n} ad accounts have spent at least 90% of their monthly budget: {names}.
notify_token_body: Your Meta access token expires in {days} days. Renew it in Settings to keep syncing.
notify_token_body_one: Your Meta access token expires within a day. Renew it in Settings to keep syncing.
notify_token_expired: Your Meta access token has expired. Renew it in Settings to resume syncing.
not_implemented: This feature is not available in this version yet.
fb_read_insights_missing: The read_insights permission is missing. It is needed for Facebook Page statistics — add it in Graph API Explorer and renew the token.
fb_page_no_analyze: The Page "{name}" was skipped: your role on it does not include the ANALYZE task (insights access). Ask a Page admin to give you insights access.
fb_page_token_missing: Could not get an access token for the Page "{name}". Check that you still manage this Page.
fb_no_pages: No Facebook Pages were found for this Meta connection.
threads_app_missing: Save the Threads App ID and App Secret first.
threads_app_id_digits: The Threads App ID must contain digits only.
threads_app_secret_short: The Threads App Secret is missing or too short.
threads_token_or_code: Paste a Threads access token or an authorization code.
threads_code_invalid: The Threads authorization code is invalid or has expired. Start the Threads login again and paste the new code.
threads_token_invalid: The Threads token is invalid. Reconnect Threads in Settings > Connections.
threads_token_expired: Your Threads connection has expired. Reconnect it in Settings > Connections.
threads_refresh_failed: The Threads token could not be refreshed ({detail}). Reconnect Threads in Settings > Connections if this persists.
threads_refresh_too_early: A Threads token can only be refreshed when it is at least 24 hours old.
threads_redirect_https: The Threads redirect URL must start with https://
notify_threads_token_body: Your Threads access token expires in {days} days and could not be refreshed automatically. Reconnect Threads in Settings.
ai_off: The AI assistant is turned off. Enable it in Settings → AI assistant.
ai_no_key: No API key is saved for {p}. Add one in Settings → AI assistant.
ai_bad_url: The Ollama address must be an http(s) URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434
ai_auth: The AI provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings → AI assistant.
ai_rate_limit: The AI provider is rate limiting requests. Try again in a minute.
ai_bad_request: The AI provider rejected the request ({status}). {detail}
ai_model_not_found: The model "{model}" is not available for this API key.
ai_server: The AI provider is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
ai_network: Could not reach the AI provider. Check your internet connection (or that Ollama is running).
ai_timeout: The AI provider took too long to answer. Try again.
ai_refusal: The AI model declined to answer this request. Try again or adjust the selection.
ai_truncated: The AI answer was cut off before any text was produced. Try again.
ai_empty: The AI provider returned an empty answer.
ai_max_steps: The AI assistant stopped after {n} steps without a final answer.
ai_prefill: Internal error: the conversation cannot end with an assistant message.
sync_locked: Another MetaDash process is already updating this data. Try again when it finishes.
sync_locked_cli: An update started from the command line is running. Try again when it finishes.
